tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description:
Check whether a specific claim about a product is supported,
        contradicted, mixed, or insufficient-data, against GYIBB's
        synthesized sources. Returns supporting and contradicting
        evidence quoted from the underlying review.

tools.name: verify_live
tools.description:

        Otherwise scans live public discussion (HackerNews, StackExchange,
        Lemmy) and returns a deterministic verdict with cited voices,

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description:
Side-by-side comparison of up to 5 GYIBB products by slug.
        Each row has rating, confidence, top 3 pros/cons, and source
        platforms.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description:
Keyword search over the GYIBB catalog. Returns up to `limit`
        matches sorted by rating descending. Pass `category` to scope
        (e.g. 'headphones', 'ai-chatbots').
